Guidance & outlook: Our Q4 FY26 EBITDA is 3.51% vis-a-vis 3.05% in Q4 FY25 and sequentially up from 3.30% in Q3 FY26.

In Q4 we delivered 2.89 lakh tonnes of steel volume, an increase of 19% year -on-year and 11% sequentially.
The PAT for FY26 was INR 128 crore, a 64% growth year-on-year.
Margins & costs: The company's EBITDA stood at INR 228 crore, a jump of 51%, translating to an expansion of 47 basis points to 3.35% for FY26 as compared to 2.87% for FY25.
